riskAssessment.reason: Tightening candidate promotion changes confirmed-evidence counts; the implementation must remove page boilerplate without dropping substantive dated claims or changing provenance/schema behavior.
riskAssessment.reviewNote: The 2026-08-25 dry-run exposed boilerplate and generic architecture descriptions in confirmed candidates. The user approved a bounded extraction-quality WI while keeping SEC, report, judgment, Ranking, and delivery unchanged.

acceptance: Document-body normalization removes navigation, header/footer/aside, form, and share/social/menu boilerplate before claim extraction while retaining substantive paragraph text.
Evidence extraction rejects UI boilerplate and generic architecture descriptions that lack an explicit production-system change action.
A concrete dated authoritative production-system change sentence still produces an EvidenceCandidate and passes the existing evidence_ validation path.
Promotion remains deterministic and preserves the existing evidence_* schema, provenance, source boundary, and snapshot/hash behavior; page-level observations remain non-evidence.
No SEC coverage, Ranking, judgment, report, Telegram, archive, persistence, dependency, or provider-call behavior changes.
Focused red-green regressions cover boilerplate rejection, generic-description rejection, and valid claim preservation.
Weekly Radar operations documentation describes the stronger normalization and explicit-change extraction boundary.
All required governance, project quality, and regression checks pass before the Work Item is finished.
guidelines: Do not add LLM/provider calls or dependencies; keep extraction deterministic.
Preserve all languages, deterministic ordering, provenance, and the existing evidence_* schema.
Page-level, UI, and source-availability observations must never become validated evidence.
Do not change the SEC, report, judgment, Ranking, persistence, or delivery boundaries.
Do not weaken or delete existing tests; add targeted red-green regression coverage.

intent.problem: The 2026-08-25 live dry-run produced eight confirmed candidates from Meta Engineering, but several snippets began with navigation/share boilerplate or described generic architecture. The gate still used whole normalized document text plus broad keywords, so reader-facing evidence remained closer to page/technical-description level than a concrete enterprise production-system change.
constraints: Only discovery body normalization and deterministic EvidenceCandidate extraction are in scope; SEC, document discovery policy, report semantics, judgment, Ranking, persistence, and delivery remain unchanged.
Keep the existing evidence_* schema, provenance, deterministic ordering, all supported report languages, and no new dependency or provider call.
Require an explicit effective date, authoritative document, production-system context, and an explicit change action for candidate promotion.
Preserve valid body claims and keep source/page observations out of ValidatedEvidence.
intent.rationale: Cleaning non-content HTML before extraction and narrowing the deterministic action-plus-production gate is the smallest change that addresses the observed false positives without expanding the system architecture.
